name: Tier list
summary: Everyone ranks the same things S to D, then sees the group's list and where they disagree.
useWhen: the chat is arguing which of several things is best: dining halls, movies, pizza places
'tier list the dining halls', 'rank the Marvel movies', 'settle this, S to D'
dontUseWhen: picking one option to do now (use a poll)

items.description: 3 to 8 things to rank, short names

name.description: Exactly as in the members list

tiers.description: One letter S, A, B, C or D per item, in order: 'ASCBAS'

ranked.description: Lists people already gave in the chat; empty if none
